question: Where is the nearest hotel located between Battle of the Bulge Memorial, VA and River Deck, Edgewater, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' ORDER BY ST_Distance( geometry::geography, ST_Centroid( ST_Collect( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Battle of the Bulge Memorial%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%River Deck%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edgewater%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ) ) )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
